pli-tv-bu-vb-pc67:1.1: tena samayena buddho bhagavā sāvatthiyaṃ viharati jetavane anāthapiṇḍikassa ārāme.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc67:1.2: tena kho pana samayena aññataro bhikkhu kosalesu janapadesu sāvatthiṃ gacchanto aññatarena gāmadvārena atikkamati.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc67:1.3: aññatarā itthī sāmikena saha bhaṇḍitvā gāmato nikkhamitvā taṃ bhikkhuṃ passitvā etadavoca
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc67:1.8: athakho tassā itthiyā sāmiko gāmato nikkhamitvā manusse pucchi
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc67:1.11: athakho so puriso anubandhitvā taṃ bhikkhuṃ gahetvā ākoṭetvā muñci.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc67:1.12: athakho so bhikkhu aññatarasmiṃ rukkhamūle padhūpento nisīdi.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc67:1.13: athakho sā itthī taṃ purisaṃ etadavoca
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc67:1.15: apica ahameva tena bhikkhunā saddhiṃ gacchāmi
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc67:1.18: athakho so puriso taṃ bhikkhuṃ khamāpesi.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc67:1.19: athakho so bhikkhu sāvatthiṃ gantvā bhikkhūnaṃ etamatthaṃ ārocesi.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc67:1.20: ye te bhikkhū appicchā …pe… te ujjhāyanti khīyanti vipācenti
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc67:1.21: kathaṃ hi nāma bhikkhu mātugāmena saddhiṃ saṃvidhāya ekaddhānamaggaṃ paṭipajjissatīti …pe…
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc67:1.22: saccaṃ kira tvaṃ bhikkhu mātugāmena saddhiṃ saṃvidhāya ekaddhānamaggaṃ paṭipajjasīti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc67:1.25: hi nāma tvaṃ moghapurisa mātugāmena saddhiṃ saṃvidhāya ekaddhānamaggaṃ paṭipajjissasi
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc67:1.26: netaṃ moghapurisa appasannānaṃ vā pasādāya pasannānaṃ vā bhiyyobhāvāya …pe…
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc67:1.27: evañca pana bhikkhave imaṃ sikkhāpadaṃ uddiseyyātha
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc67:1.28.1: yo pana bhikkhu mātugāmena saddhiṃ saṃvidhāya ekaddhānamaggaṃ paṭipajjeyya antamaso gāmantarampi pācittiyanti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc67:2.1.6: manussitthī na yakkhī na petī na tiracchānagatā viññū paṭibalā subhāsitadubbhāsitaṃ duṭṭhullāduṭṭhullaṃ ājānituṃ.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc67:2.1.10: gacchāma bhagini gacchāma ayya gacchāma ayya gacchāma bhagini ajja vā hiyyo vā pare vā gacchāmāti saṃvidahati āpatti dukkaṭassa.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc67:2.1.12: kukkuṭasampāte gāme gāmantare gāmantare āpatti pācittiyassa.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc67:2.1.13: agāmake araññe aḍḍhayojane aḍḍhayojane āpatti pācittiyassa.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc67:2.2.1: mātugāme mātugāmasaññī saṃvidhāya ekaddhānamaggaṃ paṭipajjati antamaso gāmantarampi āpatti pācittiyassa.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc67:2.2.2: mātugāme vematiko saṃvidhāya ekaddhānamaggaṃ paṭipajjati antamaso gāmantarampi āpatti pācittiyassa.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc67:2.2.3: mātugāme amātugāmasaññī saṃvidhāya ekaddhānamaggaṃ paṭipajjati antamaso gāmantarampi āpatti pācittiyassa.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc67:2.2.4: bhikkhu saṃvidahati mātugāmo na saṃvidahati āpatti dukkaṭassa.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc67:2.2.5: yakkhiyā vā petiyā vā paṇḍakena vā tiracchānagatamanussaviggahitthiyā vā saddhiṃ saṃvidhāya ekaddhānamaggaṃ paṭipajjati antamaso gāmantarampi āpatti dukkaṭassa.
